lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid of high-luminance circular clusters organized into distinct vertical rows posterior to the branchial region, with the highest-intensity maxima concentrated along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a structured matrix of high-contrast nodes against the darker base pigmentation.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature extending from the posterior margin of the gills toward the caudal region, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high specular intensity on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin's silhouette exhibits a high density of small, irregularly distributed high-luminance blobs concentrated toward the anterior and mid-sections of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four dark, elongated biological silhouettes (remoras) swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral flank of the primary subject.
